title: Audit rounded matching-layer execution and stored-coordinate widths
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR #4976's sublayer precision implication assumes that the original rounding-event count is retained. This source-bound audit proves that premise for `rational-unitary-fft/exact.py:apply` and distinguishes Euclidean amplitude from stored-component width.

Within a valid matching layer, every gate reads a saved input, computes all outputs, and rounds each output once. The rounded gate maps commute. The realized residuals aggregate into one vector per original layer, retaining the original D-layer error budget. At every completed coordinate write, the stored state is a coordinate splice of the adjacent rounded endpoints, including cuts between the outputs of a two-wire gate.

Consequently **the original fractional grid F and signed component width I remain sufficient** under the retained complete-layer stability and exact-local-arithmetic premises. A Euclidean cut radius may still increase by sqrt(2); that does not require enlarging a component-width bound. The swap witness has intermediate state (1,1), Euclidean norm sqrt(2), component bound one and a singular partial-write map. No partial inverse contract is inferred.

This explains an implicit valid step in the predecessor; it does not change its compiler, allocator, selected exponent or frozen inputs. Local products/sums and their temporary widths, coefficient preparation, tape execution and all-size conditioning remain separate obligations.

## Task and overlap

Task `uniform-transfer-audit`, priority revision 7, refined to the actual rounded-execution/word-width interface. Base: `a5df48c55ea806d7952b65acc9c76d878ff09b13`.

- #4976 at `8a7e0e9b4a085f4fb47a76700dfe135412b9c4ef` establishes exact four-way interpolation and already has an independent review. This package adds actual rounded trajectory/event accounting and per-component width preservation.
- #4977 and #5018 substitute improved allowances into Full/Gaussian allocation; their complete-layer contracts remain inputs here.
- #4829 sharpens exact dirty-shear norms; it does not audit these rounded states.

The scoped overlap check searched all 6,918 upstream local notes and targeted current PRs. Canonical main was refreshed to `ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf` before publication. Governing guidance and all declared scientific inputs were unchanged; the updated runner only changes Git-reader process cleanup. Adjacent #5153 studies coefficient-rounding guards, a distinct question from rounded output execution and component width. Public coordination pages were read, but Discussion #4202 could not be fetched and remote pagination/unpublished work were not exhausted. No exhaustive novelty claim. Exact live input pins and the full task card are in the package.

## Validation

At `6d0a6043120880c696d0850e9242a16e6fb980a5`, CPython 3.12.14, standard library only:

- Registered warning-strict normal and optimized replay passes; outputs agree byte for byte.
- Ten fixtures, 145 gate orders, 607 rounded prefix checks and 83 source coordinate writes. Two complex inputs exercise the actual n=2 Builder shear.
- Seven controls cover input overwrite, extra product rounding, overlap, residual leakage and stale exact-path residuals. Signed ties, nonzero complex rounding errors and the singular intermediate swap are explicit.
- A single observation callback records writes. Removing it reproduces the original source AST; observed/unmodified endpoints and all tracking statistics agree. Rounding and synchronous layer evaluation use an independent oracle.
- Committed-byte/source-history preflight passes for all 12 package/input files. Official export integrity passes. Both direct checks pass from the read-only 13-file export with `PATH=/nonexistent`; all bytes and modes remain unchanged. Source corruption rejects.
- Replay planning selects only this new package. Hosted CI, full multiplier/native/Lean replay and proof-kernel acceptance are unclaimed.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/matching-layer-rounding
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/matching-layer-rounding --check-source-history
```

The quantified argument is written in the package README; finite execution checks corroborate its runtime binding.

Apache-2.0; original notices are unchanged. No independent human acceptance is claimed for this contribution.

## Open next questions

The package's [open next question](https://github.com/apoursh/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6d0a6043120880c696d0850e9242a16e6fb980a5/research/matching-layer-rounding/README.md#open-next-questions) is to certify one concrete bounded-word two-coordinate multiply/add/round kernel, including signed ties and maximum temporary widths. This would connect the stored-state theorem to physical execution; that arithmetic specification remains the blocker.
